body: Spike 2 (D1, freelancer invoicing) done — memo committed at docs/strategy/spikes/spike-D1-freelancer-invoicing.md (8762acc). Headlines: (1) Constraint-7 verdict YES — Stripe Connect direct charges on Standard-default connected accounts; client pays on the freelancer's own account, we compute and read via Stripe-Account-scoped calls + invoice.* webhooks; every primitive spec-validated against stripe-mock (MIT, $0). App-fee rail is mechanically non-custodial but flagged as a one-line board-interpretation question; flat subscription is the strictest-clean default. (3) Deliverability better than feared: Stripe itself sends invoice + unpaid-invoice reminder emails on connected accounts ($0 to us, freelancer branding); DO outright blocks SMTP 25/465/587, and any custom email = board-gated ESP signup (SES/Postmark class, small $). No SMS needed in D1 v1. (4) Build sanity: 107-line zero-dep Node invoice PDF, 0.194 ms/invoice — commodity confirmed, and Stripe generates its own invoice PDF anyway. Verdict: C2=4 / C3=4 both hold, nothing moves either direction. A cofounder should relay to #bizdev — I'm not a member. Headlines: (1) SMS is gated harder than the fees — ~$21 one-time + $3-11/mo (10DLC brand/campaign/number, published Twilio/Telnyx rates) and 2-4 weeks of registration calendar, BUT both 10DLC and the toll-free path now require an EIN, so no production SMS exists until we incorporate. v1 launches email-first: cents per event via any ESP (spike-D1's deliverability groundwork cited, with one correction — D4 has no Stripe rails to hide behind, so the ESP signup is the real launch gate). Until then the 30-50%->10-15% figure stays labeled third-party. (4) Throwaway core: RSVP state machine + timing wheel in 172 LOC zero-dep Node, 9/9 tests, 40k timers in ~26ms. Verdict: C2=4 and C3=4 hold as scored. TCPA consent posture is a C5 residual for lawyer review. Cofounder relay to #bizdev requested.

body: AS-99 rework cycle 1 is done on feat/AS-99-lane-view (bac4409, b0da152, 688496f). Ruben's F1 was the real one: when the watcher reaches git and git refuses, the snapshot carries a real timestamp and an empty list, so the pane rendered 'Lanes - 0' / 'No lanes in flight' — a measurement nobody took, which is exactly the confusion the lane view exists to prevent. A refused enumeration now shows a dash badge and 'Lane data unavailable', with the snapshot's age still shown because a failed poll proves the watcher is alive and git is what broke; a STALE snapshot deliberately keeps its count, since that is a real measurement that merely stopped refreshing. The empty-state sentence is now keyed off the reason code rather than the rendered badge string, which was the mechanism that let the two states collapse into one. F2: a worktree outside the repo root (git worktree add /tmp/foo is legal) was leaking its absolute host path into the projection and into the lane key; it now reads '<outside repo>/<basename>', keeping the basename so two outside worktrees stay distinct lanes. Host suite 416 -> 420, all passing; 5 site-anchored mutants on scratch copies, all red, no survivors. Still owed before done: the counted docker compose --build receipt (docker is denied in headless ticks) and the live UI probes.
